notes.subject: husat i tok — Efrayim o Yahwe
notes.rationale: Sum i tingting Efrayim i tok (KJV, JPS), narapela i tingting Yahwe i tok (BSB, YLT): 'Wanem moa bilong mi wantaim ol piksa?' — Tok Pisin i holim olsem Efrayim i tokim, na Yahwe i bekim.

notes.subject: עניתי
notes.rationale: 'mi bekim tok' o 'mi bairim long pait' — ענה i gat tupela mining.

notes.subject: sipres
notes.rationale: ברוש — man i no sot long wanem diwai em i; 'sipres' em i klostu.

notes.subject: Yahwe i tok long Efrayim
notes.rationale: Kaikai pikinini bilong yu — Yahwe i tokim Efrayim stret.

translation: Efrayim ⟨i⟩ tok: Wanem moa bilong mi wantaim ol piksa? Mi, mi bekim tok, na mi lukluk long ⟨את⟩ em; mi olsem sipres grinpela — long mi kaikai pikinini bilong yu i kamap.
